name: mySEOTop — AI Meta Tags
author: rluizbarbosa

sections.description:
mySEOTop is a leading AI-driven SEO and GEO/AEO (Generative Engine Optimization) analysis platform.

This plugin seamlessly connects your WordPress website to the mySEOTop dashboard and automatically applies AI-generated, highly optimized meta tags (Title, Description, OpenGraph, Canonical, and Schema JSON-LD) to every page of your site while maintaining instant page load performance.

External Service & SaaS Integration

This plugin connects to our external API (https://myseotop.com/api) to fetch and sync your AI-optimized meta tags when a page is requested.
* Service: mySEOTop API (SaaS Platform)
* Terms of Service: https://myseotop.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://myseotop.com/privacy

Key Features

  • Native Title (<title>) Control: Clean interception via the native pre_get_document_title filter, preventing duplicate tags with modern themes (title-tag).
  • Schema JSON-LD & GEO/AEO Support: Secure injection of AI Structured Data to dominate artificial intelligence answers and Google rich snippets.
  • Smart Competitor Compatibility: Support and option to seamlessly disable competing meta tags (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress) without conflicts.
  • Admin Bar Quick Action: Clear the cache of a specific page with just 1 click directly from the top admin bar (✨ mySEOTop: Clear Cache) as you browse your website.
  • Ignored URLs Support: Define wildcard patterns (e.g., /cart/*, /checkout/*) to ignore routes where SEO tags should not be modified.
  • High-Performance Caching: Meta tags are cached locally using the WordPress Transients API for 1 hour, ensuring zero server latency.
  • Secure Fallback: If the external API is offline or undergoing maintenance, your original WordPress meta tags are preserved without breaking page layout.

How It Works

  1. Create a free account at myseotop.com
  2. Add your website and analyze your pages
  3. Generate AI-optimized meta tags (Title, Description, OpenGraph)
  4. Review and approve tags in your platform dashboard
  5. Install this plugin and paste your API Key under Settings → mySEOTop
  6. Done! Approved tags are automatically applied and cached on your site pages.

GEO/AEO — Optimization for Generative AI Engines

mySEOTop analyzes and structures your metadata and Schema Markup so your brand is referenced and recommended by the leading AI engines:

  • ChatGPT Search & OpenAI
  • Perplexity AI
  • Google AI Overviews & Gemini
  • Claude & Microsoft Copilot (Bing)

Developed By

WD Seven — Technology and innovation company driving business excellence.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the myseotop folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or upload the .zip archive via Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin)
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → mySEOTop
  4. Paste your API Key (found at myseotop.com/dashboard → Your Site → API Key)
  5. Click “Save and Test Connection”

Obtaining Your API Key

  1. Visit myseotop.com
  2. Create your free account or sign in to your dashboard
  3. Navigate to My Sites → select your website → copy the API Key
  4. Paste the API Key into the plugin settings page inside your WordPress dashboard
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid account to use this plugin?

No! You get 1 complete AI page analysis for free upon registration. For higher volume needs and automated bulk generation, check out our plans at myseotop.com/pricing.

Does this plugin work alongside Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, or SEOPress?

Yes! You can run them together (for instance, letting Yoast or Rank Math generate your sitemap.xml) while checking the “Disable meta tags from other SEO plugins” option in mySEOTop settings. This allows our AI to take 100% control over Title, Description, OpenGraph, and Schema markup without generating duplicates.

Are the tags generated and validated by AI?

Yes! We use advanced AI models to generate optimized meta tags based on the actual page content, long-tail keywords, and search intent (AEO). You maintain total control to review and approve tags in the dashboard before they go live.

How do I clear the cache when I approve new tags on the dashboard?

You have two simple ways:
1. Inside your WordPress admin dashboard at Settings -> mySEOTop -> Clear entire site cache.
2. Browsing directly to the updated page on your website and clicking ✨ mySEOTop: Clear Cache on the top WordPress admin bar.

Does this impact website page load speed (Core Web Vitals)?

No! After the first page load, the meta tags are stored in your WordPress local database (via Transients API) for 1 hour. No extra API requests are made during normal visitor browsing.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Optimized <title> interception hook (template_redirect + prepare_meta_tags) ensuring AI title is ready before pre_get_document_title execution.
  • Enhanced score verification crawler (extractPageContent), prioritizing intelligent reading of the last injected tag on WordPress sites and SSR frameworks.

1.1.0

  • Native <title> control via pre_get_document_title filter to prevent duplicate title tags in modern themes.
  • Expanded support for Schema Markup (<script type="application/ld+json">) and GEO/OpenGraph attributes in wp_kses().
  • Added support and conflict-free deactivation for Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress.
  • Added top WordPress admin bar shortcut (wp_admin_bar) to clear single-page meta tag cache with 1 click.
  • Added ignored URLs setting with wildcard support (/cart/*, /checkout/*).
  • Improved diagnostics dashboard showing detected competitor plugins.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Automatic injection of meta tags via mySEOTop API.
  • WordPress Transients local caching (1 hour).
  • Compatibility with Yoast SEO.
  • Settings page with diagnostics and API health check.
  • HTTPS support and secure fallback.
